question: Why did the catechol purity at the column top fall when the operating pressure of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa?
expect: premise false: it ROSE from 0.94377 to 0.99996 (sec. 4.1)
rendered: According to the document, the catechol purity at the column top increased when the operating pressure was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa, not fell.
